description: Source code implementing the xoshiro128++ 1.0 pseudorandom number generator for Zephyr OS, including entropy initialization and random number generation functions.

methods.name: rotl
methods.description: Performs a left rotation on a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: xoshiro128_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the entropy driver, returns error if device not ready.

methods.name: xoshiro128_init_state
methods.description: Seeds the PRNG state with entropy or pseudo-random data.

methods.name: xoshiro128_next
methods.description: Generates the next 32-bit random number using xoshiro128++ algorithm.
